chains.label: 从「李二在桥边找灯笼」传成「李家眼红周家出风头，故意毁了桥」

failed.en: Something went wrong and the goods did not get there
failed.zh: 路上出了岔子，货没能送到

late.en: It did not arrive in time
late.zh: 没赶在约好的时间前送到

rain.en: The heavy rain kept the goods off the road

taken_back.en: Word is they changed their mind

clarified.en: {manager} told everyone the talk had gone too far. {names} changed their minds.
clarified.zh: {manager}当众讲明，那话传过了头。{names}听了，改了口。

delivery.en: The {amount} poles of {item} that {who} promised have reached the {place}.

entities.label: 点主灯的体面
entities.label_en: The Honour of Lighting the Main Lantern

evidence.label: 小满说，那晚看见船撞上了栏杆
evidence.label_en: Xiaoman's word: a boat struck the railing that night

evidence.label: 账房的修船记录
evidence.label_en: The accountant's record of the boat repair

evidence.label: 卡在桥墩上的上游断木
evidence.label_en: Upstream driftwood caught on the pier

evidence.label: 更夫说，水头打上桥那会儿桥边没有人
evidence.label_en: The night watchman's word: a surge of water hit the bridge and nobody was by it

evidence.label: 更夫说，桥下有个撑船的黑影
evidence.label_en: The night watchman's word: a dark shape poling a boat under the bridge

evidence.label: 庙祝说，老何家那晚的灯一直亮到半夜
evidence.label_en: The temple keeper's word: a lamp burned at Boatman He's house until midnight

evidence.label: 周家伙计说，周家大郎那晚一回家就睡到了天亮
evidence.label_en: The clerk's word: Zhou Dalang went home and slept until dawn

evidence.label: 更夫说，看见周家大郎醉醺醺地上了桥
evidence.label_en: The night watchman's word: Zhou Dalang, drunk, walked onto the bridge

evidence.label: 断栏边带酒气的鞋印
evidence.label_en: A shoeprint smelling of wine by the broken railing

evidence.label: 周家伙计说，自己只讲过看见李二在桥边
evidence.label_en: The clerk's word: I only said I saw Li Er by the bridge

evidence.label: 李二说，那晚是在找掉进水里的灯笼
evidence.label_en: Li Er's word: I was looking for the lantern I dropped in the water

flags.label: 族长接受了当众说清的真相

any.label: 毁桥的谣言已经当众澄清，她自己知道了
给李家一个灯会上的体面角色，并且她对你的信任到一定程度
族长亲自开口，而族长先要被你说动

label: 断桥

metrics.label: 当众说清时在场的有名有姓的人数
在场者接受真相的百分比
终夜时相信主冲突假命题的有名有姓者百分比

observations.label: 李二在桥边找掉进水里的灯笼
桥墩上留着高水位的水痕
大郎昨夜在酒肆喝到很晚，今早不肯出门
老何的船身上有新刮痕

openings.label: 昨夜到今晨，「李二弄坏了栏杆」已经在周家和茶馆传开

bridge_mended.en: The Stone Bridge is mended, and the two banks are joined again.
bridge_mended.zh: 石桥修好了，两岸又通了。

evidence.en: {manager} showed the proof in public at the {place}. Some people believed it.
evidence.zh: {manager}在{place}当众拿出了凭据。有人信了。

evidence_refused.en: {manager} showed the proof in public at the {place}. Nobody believed it.
evidence_refused.zh: {manager}在{place}当众拿出了凭据。没一个人信。

helpers.en: {n} more people agreed to help at the bridge.

meal.en: The heads of the two families shared a meal. Others saw it.
meal.zh: 两家当家坐在一张桌上吃了顿饭。旁人都看见了。

rain_heavy.en: Heavy rain fell {when}. The streets emptied.
rain_heavy.zh: {when}下了一场大雨。街上没什么人。

reconciled.en: The heads of the Li and Zhou families sat at one table. The two families have made peace.
reconciled.zh: 李、周两家的当家坐到了一张桌上。两家和好了。

side_by_side.en: People of both families worked at the bridge together.
side_by_side.zh: 两家的人一起在桥边干了活。

statement.en: {manager} told the town at the {place} how the bridge broke. Some people nodded.
statement.zh: {manager}在{place}当众讲了桥是怎么坏的。有人点了头。

statement_refused.en: {manager} told the town at the {place} how the bridge broke. Nobody nodded.
statement_refused.zh: {manager}在{place}当众讲了桥是怎么坏的。没一个人点头。

stopped.en: {who} has stopped speaking ill of {other} in public.
stopped.zh: {who}当着大家的面，不再说{other}的不是了。

truth_told.en: How the bridge broke has been told in public.
truth_told.zh: 桥是怎么坏的，已经当众说清楚了。

two_accounts.en: The street has two stories. Some say that {first}. Others say that {second}.
two_accounts.zh: 街上有两种说法。有人说{first}。也有人说{second}。

festival_cool.en: Hardly anyone on the street speaks of the festival. Some say there is little heart for it this year.
festival_cool.zh: 街上没几个人提灯会。有人说，今年怕是没什么兴致。

festival_down.en: Fewer people on the street look forward to the festival than yesterday. The teahouse hardly mentions it.
festival_down.zh: 街上盼灯会的人比昨天少了。茶馆里也没几个人提灯会。

festival_mixed.en: Some on the street look forward to the festival, and others want to wait and see.
festival_mixed.zh: 街上有人盼着灯会，也有人说再看看。

festival_up.en: More people on the street look forward to the festival than yesterday. The children keep asking when the lanterns go up.
festival_up.zh: 街上盼灯会的人比昨天多了。孩子们追着问什么时候挂灯。

festival_warm.en: The street talks of little but the festival. People are already counting the lanterns at each door.
festival_warm.zh: 街上都在说灯会。哪家挂几盏灯，已经有人在数了。

li_more.en: More people on the street than yesterday are speaking up for the Li family.
li_more.zh: 街上向着李家说话的人，比昨天又多了些。

li_side.en: More people on the street speak up for the Li family than for the Zhou family.
li_side.zh: 街上向着李家说话的人多些。

peace.en: The street is saying that the heads of the Li and Zhou families have sat down at one table.
peace.zh: 街上都在说，李、周两家的当家坐到一张桌上去了。

split.en: The street has split into two camps, one for the Li family and one for the Zhou family. Neither can win the other over.
split.zh: 街上分成了两拨，一拨向着李家，一拨向着周家。谁也说不服谁。

talked_out.en: The street is still talking about what was set out in public. The old stories are heard less.
talked_out.zh: 街上还在说当众说清的那件事。旧话没什么人提了。

walk_call.en: There was more coming and going between neighbours yesterday. Some called on one another to talk.
walk_call.zh: 昨天街坊之间走动得多些。有人专程登门说话。

walk_hand.en: Some people lent a hand at the bridge yesterday.
walk_hand.zh: 昨天有人到桥边搭了把手。

walk_look.en: Some people made a point of going down to look at the bridge yesterday.
walk_look.zh: 昨天有人特地去桥边看了看。

zhou_more.en: More people on the street than yesterday are speaking up for the Zhou family.
zhou_more.zh: 街上向着周家说话的人，比昨天又多了些。

zhou_side.en: More people on the street speak up for the Zhou family than for the Li family.
zhou_side.zh: 街上向着周家说话的人多些。

speculation.label: 当时在现场，又与说话人所在的家结怨，就推测是这个人弄坏的
秋汛涨水，栏杆又塌了，就推测是汛水冲的
有人昨夜喝了酒，栏杆又塌了，就推测是这个人酒后弄坏的
船身有新刮痕，栏杆又塌了，就推测是船主撞的

text.en: Boatman He's boat struck the railing in the night
text.zh: 船夫老何夜里撑船，船头撞断了栏杆

text.en: The flood water loosened the old joints and the railing gave way by itself
text.zh: 秋汛的水头冲松了旧榫，栏杆自己断了

text.en: Zhou Dalang, drunk, kicked the railing down
text.zh: 周家大郎喝醉了酒，一脚踢断了栏杆

text.en: Li Er broke the railing
Boatman He poled under the bridge in the night and the bow struck the railing. Afterwards the boatman quietly mended the boat
text.zh: 船夫老何夜里撑船从桥下过，船头撞上了栏杆。事后老何悄悄把船修好了

text.en: The flood water hit the bridge in the night and loosened the old joints. The railing gave way by itself, with nobody on the bridge or under it
text.zh: 夜里水头打上桥，把旧榫冲松了。栏杆是自己断的，桥上桥下都没有人

text.en: Zhou Dalang got drunk at the tavern in the night, staggered onto the bridge and kicked the railing down
text.zh: 周家大郎夜里在酒肆喝醉了。晃到桥上，一脚踢断了栏杆

text.en: Li Er went to the bridge in the night and broke the railing
text.zh: 夜里李二到桥边，下手弄断了栏杆

text.en: Zhou's Clerk only saw Li Er at the bridge looking for a lantern. Shopkeeper Zhou, holding an old grudge, guessed that Li Er broke the railing. The story grew as it went round and picked up “on purpose” and “envy”
text.zh: 周家伙计只看见李二在桥边找灯笼。周掌柜记着旧怨，猜是李二弄坏的。话越传越重，又添上了「故意」「眼红」

text.en: Li Er really did break the railing, and Zhou's Clerk saw it happen
text.zh: 李二真的弄坏了栏杆，周家伙计亲眼看见了

text.en: Zhou's Clerk made it up, and Li Er was not at the bridge that night
text.zh: 周家伙计编了瞎话，李二那晚根本不在桥边

text.en: The Zhou family spread it on purpose to ruin the name of the Li family
text.zh: 周家故意把话传出去，想坏了李家的名声

summary: 秋汛后石桥栏杆塌了一段，游灯路线过不去，李、周两家互相指责。

blocker.en: The Li family will not give the bamboo

next.en: Find out who started that talk.
next.zh: 问清这话是谁先说的。

why.en: The town is saying Li Er broke the bridge. Granny Li is angry that you, the manager, have said nothing.
why.zh: 镇上都在传李二毁了桥。李老太怪你这个总管一声不吭。

blocker.en: Granny Li still will not lend the bamboo
blocker.zh: 李老太还是不肯借竹料

next.en: Find out who spread the rumour, then set it straight in public.
next.zh: 先查清这句闲话是谁传的，再当众说清。

why.en: Granny Li will not lend it until the talk about Li Er is set straight in public.
why.zh: 李老太要等李二的事当众说清了，才肯借。

blocker.en: Li Da has not heard that the talk was set straight
blocker.zh: 李大还不知道那句闲话已经说清了

next.en: Tell Li Da the talk was set straight, then ask Li Da for the bamboo.
next.zh: 先告诉李大那事已经当众说清了，再请李大送竹料。

why.en: Li Da was not there when it was set straight, and nobody has told Li Da since.
why.zh: 当众说清那会儿李大不在场，事后也没人跟李大提。

blocker.en: Li Da will not send the bamboo yet

next.en: Promise Li Da something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许李大一样东西，再请李大送。

next.en: Ask Li Da again when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，再请李大送。

why.en: Li Da does not trust you yet, or feels you still owe a favour.
why.zh: 李大还信不过你，或者嫌你上回欠的人情没还。

next.en: Be at the bridge at the agreed time and see the bamboo arrive.
next.zh: 按约好的时间去桥边，看竹料送到没有。

next.en: Ask Li Da to bring the first load of bamboo to the bridge.
next.zh: 请李大把第一批竹料送到桥边。

next.en: Go to the Li house and ask Granny Li to lend the bamboo.
next.zh: 去李家，请李老太借竹料。

text.en: Get the first load of bamboo from the Li family
text.zh: 借到李家的第一批竹料

why.en: Li Da has promised to bring {bamboo_open} poles of bamboo to the bridge.
why.zh: 李大答应把{bamboo_open}根竹料送到桥边。

why.en: Granny Li has given way. The bamboo is Li Da's to bring.
why.zh: 李老太松口了。竹料归李大管。

why.en: The bamboo for the bridge is with the Li family.
why.zh: 修桥的竹料在李家。

next.en: Trace the talk back one person at a time, asking each who told them.
next.zh: 一个个往回问「你是听谁说的」。

next.en: Ask around who they heard it from.
next.zh: 问问镇上的人，这话是听谁说的。

text.en: Who said Li Er broke the bridge?

why.en: Because of that talk, the Li family will not give the bamboo.
why.zh: 就因为这句话，李家不肯给竹料。

next.en: Put the two lines side by side and see how they relate.
next.zh: 把这两句话摆在一起比一比，看它们是什么关系。

text.en: What does the clerk's word show?
text.zh: 周家伙计看见的，能说明什么？

why.en: Zhou's Clerk only says Li Er was at the bridge. The town says Li Er broke it.
why.zh: 周家伙计只说看见李二在桥边。镇上传的却是李二毁了桥。

next.en: Take the two lines you compared and set it straight in public.
next.zh: 拿着你比过的那两句话，去当众说清。

text.en: Set the talk about Li Er straight in public

why.en: You have kept quiet, and Granny Li takes that to mean you agree. So the bamboo stays where it is.
why.zh: 你一直不吭声，李老太就当你认了这话。竹料也就不借了。

next.en: Go to the teahouse in the evening and speak in front of everyone.
next.zh: 傍晚去茶馆，当着大家的面说。

text.en: To the teahouse tonight

why.en: The teahouse fills up in the evening, and everyone there will hear you.
why.zh: 傍晚茶馆里人多，你说的话大家都听得到。

next.en: Be at the bridge at the agreed time and see that it arrives.
next.zh: 按约好的时间去桥边，看竹料送到没有。

text.en: The bamboo that Li Da promised

why.en: Li Da agreed to bring it to the bridge at the agreed time.
why.zh: 李大答应按约好的时间送到桥边。

blocker.en: Li Da will not send another batch

next.en: Promise Li Da something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许李大一样东西，再请李大送。

next.en: Ask Li Da again when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，再请李大送。

why.en: Li Da does not trust you yet, or feels you still owe a favour.
why.zh: 李大还信不过你，或者嫌你上回欠的人情没还。

next.en: Be at the bridge at the agreed time and see the bamboo arrive.
next.zh: 按约好的时间去桥边，看竹料送到没有。

next.en: Ask Li Da for another batch.
next.zh: 再请李大送一批。

text.en: The rest of the bamboo

why.en: The bridge needs {bamboo_need} poles of bamboo and has {bamboo_site}. Li Da has promised {bamboo_open} more.
why.zh: 桥要{bamboo_need}根竹料，已经到了{bamboo_site}根。李大又答应送{bamboo_open}根。

why.en: The bridge needs {bamboo_need} poles of bamboo and only {bamboo_site} lie there.
why.zh: 桥要{bamboo_need}根竹料，桥边才有{bamboo_site}根。

blocker.en: Shopkeeper Zhou will not give the timber

next.en: Promise Shopkeeper Zhou something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许周掌柜一件事，再请周掌柜送木料。

next.en: Ask Shopkeeper Zhou again when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，再请周掌柜送木料。

why.en: Timber is the Zhou trade, and Shopkeeper Zhou does not give it away.
why.zh: 木料是周家的买卖，周掌柜不会白给。

next.en: Be at the bridge at the agreed time and see the timber arrive.
next.zh: 按约好的时间去桥边，看木料送到没有。

next.en: Ask Shopkeeper Zhou to bring the timber to the bridge.
next.zh: 请周掌柜把木料送到桥边。

text.en: Get the timber from the Zhou family

why.en: Shopkeeper Zhou has promised to bring {timber_open} poles of timber to the bridge.
why.zh: 周掌柜答应把{timber_open}根木料送到桥边。

why.en: The bridge needs {timber_need} poles of timber, and they have to come from the Zhou store.
why.zh: 修桥要{timber_need}根木料，得从周家库里出。

blocker.en: {helper} has not agreed to come yet

next.en: Promise {helper} something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许{helper}一件事，再请{helper}来帮忙。

why.en: {helper} wants something in return before joining.
why.zh: {helper}想先得点好处，才肯来帮忙。

next.en: Call for helpers first, and those who are willing will come.
next.zh: 先召集帮手，愿意的人会自己来。

next.en: Ask someone from {needy} to help.
next.zh: 请{needy}的人来帮忙。

next.en: Ask one more person to help.
next.zh: 再请一个人来帮忙。

text.en: Find helpers

why.en: The bridge takes {crew} helpers, at least one from each family.
why.zh: 修桥要{crew}个帮手，李家、周家至少各出一个。

blocker.en: Heavy rain today, so there is no work on the bridge
blocker.zh: 今天下大雨，桥上开不了工

next.en: Wait for the rain to stop and come again in the morning.
next.zh: 等雨停，明早再来。

why.en: No work is done in heavy rain. What is left has to wait for tomorrow morning.
why.zh: 下大雨不开工。剩下的活只能等明早再干。

next.en: Be at the bridge in the morning and see the work begin.
next.zh: 早上去桥边，看帮手开工。

text.en: Work on the bridge, the third morning

why.en: With the helpers you have, the bridge will not be done in time.
why.zh: 照眼下这几个帮手，期限前桥修不完。

why.en: With these helpers, {work_mornings} and the bridge is done.
why.zh: 照这几个帮手，再干{work_mornings}桥就修完了。

blocker.en: Heavy rain today, so there is no work on the bridge
blocker.zh: 今天下大雨，桥上开不了工

next.en: The bridge cannot be finished. Only the detour is left.
next.zh: 桥修不完了，只能走绕路。

why.en: No work is done in heavy rain, and this is the last morning.
why.zh: 下大雨不开工。今天又是最后一个早上。

next.en: Be at the bridge in the morning and see the work begin.
next.zh: 早上去桥边，看帮手开工。

text.en: Work on the bridge, the fourth morning

why.en: Tomorrow morning is the last one. With these helpers, the work will not be done by then.
why.zh: 明早是最后一个早上。照这几个帮手，明早干不完。

why.en: This is the last morning. With these helpers, the work will not be done today.
why.zh: 今天是最后一个早上。照这几个帮手，今天干不完。

why.en: Tomorrow morning is the last one. With these helpers, the bridge will be done by then.
why.zh: 明早是最后一个早上。照这几个帮手，明早就能把桥修完。

why.en: This is the last morning. With these helpers, the bridge will be done today.
why.zh: 今天是最后一个早上。照这几个帮手，今天就能把桥修完。

blocker.en: The temple keeper will not open the lane yet

next.en: Promise the temple keeper something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许庙祝一件事，再请庙祝打开夹道。

next.en: Ask the temple keeper again when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，再请庙祝打开夹道。

why.en: The lane is kept locked, and the temple keeper does not open it for just anyone.
why.zh: 夹道平时锁着，庙祝不轻易开。

next.en: Wait a little, and the lane will be open.
next.zh: 等一会儿，夹道就开了。

next.en: Ask a few more people to help. The helpers hang the lanterns in the afternoon.
next.zh: 再请几个人来帮忙。下午帮手会去夹道挂灯。

next.en: The helpers hang lanterns along the lane from 13:00 to 17:00. Go and look at the temple.
next.zh: 帮手们 13:00 到 17:00 沿夹道挂灯。去庙那边看看。

next.en: Ask the temple keeper to open the lane behind the temple.
next.zh: 请庙祝打开庙后的夹道。

text.en: Get a detour ready

why.en: The temple keeper has agreed to open the lane, and three people still have to hang lanterns along it. The festival can go on by the detour, but the night cannot be perfect.
why.zh: 庙祝答应开夹道了。还得有三个人沿路挂灯。走绕路也能办灯会，只是算不上圆满。

why.en: The lane is open, and three people still have to hang lanterns along it. The festival can go on by the detour, but the night cannot be perfect.
why.zh: 夹道开了。还得有三个人沿路挂灯。走绕路也能办灯会，只是算不上圆满。

why.en: The bridge may not be mended in time. The festival can go on by the detour, but the night cannot be perfect.
why.zh: 桥怕是来不及修好了。走绕路也能办灯会，只是算不上圆满。

next.en: Go to the bridge by day and see what was left by the broken railing. After the second day the marks are trodden out.
next.zh: 白天去桥上看看断栏边留下了什么。过了第二天，印子就被踩没了。

next.en: The water under the bridge has dropped, so go and look at what shows on the pier.
next.zh: 桥墩下的水落下去了，去看看露出了什么。

next.en: The boat's owner will not let you look yet. Go and talk first.
next.zh: 船主还不让你看船。先去聊几句。

next.en: The boat's owner will not let you look yet. Promise something and come back.
next.zh: 船主还不让你看船。许点好处再来。

next.en: The boat's owner does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow.
next.zh: 船主还信不过你。明天再去聊聊。

next.en: Go to the ferry and look at the boat.
next.zh: 去渡口看看那条船。

next.en: The night watchman will not speak yet. Go and talk first.
next.zh: 更夫还不肯开口。先去聊几句。

next.en: The night watchman will not speak yet. Promise something and ask again.
next.zh: 更夫还不肯开口。许点好处再来问。

next.en: The night watchman does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow afternoon.
next.zh: 更夫还信不过你。明天下午再去聊聊。

next.en: The night watchman is at the watch post in the afternoon. Ask what was seen that night.
next.zh: 下午更夫在更铺里。去问问那晚看见了什么。

next.en: Xiaoman will not speak yet. Go and talk first.
next.zh: 小满还不肯开口。先去聊几句。

next.en: Xiaoman will not speak yet. Promise something and ask again.
next.zh: 小满还不肯开口。许点好处再来问。

next.en: Xiaoman does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow evening.
next.zh: 小满还信不过你。明天傍晚再去聊聊。

next.en: Xiaoman fishes by the river at night and is home in the evening. Ask what was seen that night.
next.zh: 小满夜里常在河边钓鱼，傍晚在家。去问问那晚看见了什么。

next.en: There is nothing more to see today. On the third morning the water drops and the pier can be seen.
next.zh: 今天能看的都看了。第三天早上水落下去，再去看桥墩。

next.en: The water has dropped. Look at the pier by day and see Xiaoman in the evening.
next.zh: 水落下去了。白天去看桥墩，傍晚去找小满。

next.en: See Xiaoman in the evening and ask what was seen that night.
next.zh: 傍晚去找小满，问问那晚看见了什么。

next.en: You have done all you can today. The night watchman will not speak before the afternoon of the fourth day.
next.zh: 今天能查的都查了。更夫要到第四天下午才肯开口。

next.en: Find the night watchman at the watch post in the afternoon and ask what was seen that night.
next.zh: 下午去更铺找更夫，问问那晚看见了什么。

next.en: By day go to the bridge and the ferry, in the evening see Xiaoman, and on the fourth afternoon the night watchman.
next.zh: 白天去桥上和渡口看看，傍晚找小满。第四天下午再找更夫。

text.en: How did the bridge really break?

why.en: Nobody in town knows for sure how the railing broke. Find the people who saw it, and look at what was left behind.
why.zh: 栏杆是怎么断的，镇上谁也说不准。得找亲眼看见的人问问，再去看看留下了什么。

next.en: Open the card at the marked part. Look and ask more, or choose another account, and speak again next time.
next.zh: 翻开讲稿，看标出的那一条。再去查、去问，或者换个说法。下回再去说。

next.en: Your proof is not enough yet. Look and ask in more places. Once it can tell the stories apart, speak again next time.
next.zh: 凭据还不够。再去几处看看、问问。等凭据分得出是哪种说法，下回再去说。

next.en: Speak when more people are there. The teahouse is fullest from 17:00 to 19:00. You can also ask the elder in the morning to call the clan to the hall.
next.zh: 等人多的时候再说。傍晚 17:00 到 19:00 茶馆里人最多。也可以上午请族长把族人召集到祠堂。

next.en: Bring more proof by looking and asking in more places, then speak again.
next.zh: 再去几处看看、问问。凭据多了，再当众说一次。

next.en: It only counts with the elder there. The elder is at the teahouse in the evening. You can also ask the elder to call the clan to the hall.
next.zh: 族长要在场才算数。族长傍晚在茶馆。也可以请族长把族人召集到祠堂。

next.en: Talk with the elder until the elder trusts you. Keep the promises you made. Then speak again with the proof that rules out the other account.
next.zh: 先去跟族长聊聊，让族长信得过你。许过的事要兑现。再拿着能驳倒另一种说法的凭据，当众说一次。

next.en: The elder has called the clan to the hall. Go and speak there.
next.zh: 族长把族人召集到祠堂了。去祠堂当众说清楚。

next.en: Speak at the teahouse. It is fullest from 17:00 to 19:00. You can also ask the elder in the morning to call the clan to the hall.
next.zh: 去茶馆当众说清楚。傍晚 17:00 到 19:00 那儿人最多。也可以上午请族长把族人召集到祠堂。

next.en: You have spoken in public today. Come again next time.
next.zh: 今天已经当众说过了，下回再来。

next.en: The card is not complete yet. Find out what is missing first, then go and speak.
next.zh: 讲稿还没写全。先把缺的那几条查清楚，再去说。

next.en: The card is filled in. You can speak at the public meeting on the evening of the fourth day.
next.zh: 讲稿写好了。要等第四天傍晚的公议，才能当众说。

next.en: Look and ask until the card is complete. Then speak at the public meeting on the evening of the fourth day.
next.zh: 先去查、去问，把讲稿写全。第四天傍晚到公议上当众说清楚。

text.en: Tell the town how the bridge broke

why.en: A part did not hold last time. The card marks which one.
why.zh: 上回有一条没站住。讲稿上标出了是哪一条。

why.en: Every part held last time, but your proof cannot tell the stories apart. People were not convinced.
why.zh: 上回每一条都对，可你的凭据分不出是哪种说法。大家不服。

why.en: Too few people were there last time, and the word did not carry.
why.zh: 上回在场的人太少，话传不开。

why.en: Last time too few of those there were convinced.
why.zh: 上回在场的人，点头的不够多。

why.en: The elder was not there last time. Without the elder's nod it does not count.
why.zh: 上回族长不在场。族长不点头，说了也不算数。

why.en: The proof held last time, and the elder was there. But the elder did not nod, either still holding to another account or not trusting you yet.
why.zh: 上回凭据够了，族长也在场。可族长没点头，要么还信着另一种说法，要么还信不过你。

why.en: How the bridge broke has to be said in public, part by part, before the families and the town will believe it.
why.zh: 桥是怎么坏的，得在公议上一条一条说清楚。这样两家和镇上的人才会信。

next.en: Seat both heads together at the teahouse in the evening, with at least three others there to see it.
next.zh: 傍晚去茶馆摆一桌，请两家当家坐到一起。旁边得有三个以上的人看着。

next.en: Lay another table on another evening and seat both heads together, with at least three others there to see it.
next.zh: 改天傍晚再摆一桌，请两家当家坐到一起。旁边得有三个以上的人看着。

next.en: Tell the town how the bridge broke first, then lay another table on another day.
next.zh: 先把桥的事当众说清楚，改天再摆一桌。

next.en: Lay a table at the teahouse in the evening and seat both heads together, with at least three others there to see it.
next.zh: 傍晚去茶馆摆一桌，请两家当家坐到一起。旁边得有三个以上的人看着。

next.en: Be at the bridge from 08:00 to 12:00. When helpers of both families work side by side, the two heads cool down a little.
next.zh: 08:00 到 12:00 去桥边。两家的帮手一起干活，两家当家的气就能消一些。

next.en: First tell the town how the bridge broke. Then lay a table at the teahouse and seat both heads together. At least three others have to be there to see it.
next.zh: 先把桥的事当众说清楚。再去茶馆摆一桌，请两家当家坐到一起。旁边得有三个以上的人看着。

text.en: Make peace between the families

why.en: The bad blood has eased, but nobody has yet seen the two families make peace.
why.zh: 两家的气消了不少，可还没人亲眼看见两家和好。

why.en: People saw the families make peace, but the two heads are still angry.
why.zh: 有人看见两家和好了，可两家当家心里的气还没消。

why.en: The truth about the bridge is out. A meal now does the most to ease the bad blood between the two heads.
why.zh: 桥的事说清了。这时候摆一桌，最能消两家当家的气。

why.en: The two heads are still angry with each other, and one meal will not settle it.
why.zh: 两家当家的心里还憋着气，一顿饭解不开。

next.en: Finish what is left before dark, then be at the bridge.
next.zh: 天黑前把没办完的事办完，再到桥边去。

text.en: Festival night

why.en: Tonight the lantern parade crosses. How the night goes depends on whether there is a way across, and on how many of the three jobs are done.
why.zh: 今晚游灯的队伍要过桥。这一夜成不成，看路通不通，也看三件事办成了几件。

lapse.en: You promised {pledge1_to} {pledge1_what} by {pledge1_due} and did not keep it. {pledge1_to} trusts you less now. Word of it will go round the town.
lapse.zh: 你答应最迟{pledge1_due}给{pledge1_to}的{pledge1_what}，没给成。{pledge1_to}更不信你了。这事还会在镇上传开。

next.en: Go to {pledge1_to} today and keep it in person.
next.zh: 今天去找{pledge1_to}，当面兑现。

next.en: On {pledge1_due}, go to {pledge1_to} and keep it in person, or sooner.
next.zh: {pledge1_due}去找{pledge1_to}当面兑现，早点去也行。

next.en: Go and tell Granny Li that the matter was set straight in public.
next.zh: 去告诉李老太，桥的事已经当众说清了。

next.en: Ask Granny Li for the bamboo again.
next.zh: 再请李老太借竹料。

next.en: Go to the bridge by day and see what was left by the broken railing.
next.zh: 白天去桥上看看断栏边留下了什么。

next.en: Look at the water under the bridge.
next.zh: 去看看桥墩下面的水面。

next.en: Zhou's Clerk passed the bridge that night. Ask what the clerk saw.
next.zh: 周家伙计那晚从桥边走过。去问问看见了什么。

next.en: The boat's owner will not let you look yet. Go and talk first.
next.zh: 船主还不让你看船。先去聊几句。

next.en: The boat's owner will not let you look yet. Promise something and come back.
next.zh: 船主还不让你看船。许点好处再来。

next.en: The boat's owner does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow.
next.zh: 船主还信不过你。明天再去聊聊。

next.en: Go to the ferry and look at the boat.
next.zh: 去渡口看看那条船。

next.en: Xiaoman will not speak yet. Go and talk first.
next.zh: 小满还不肯开口。先去聊几句。

next.en: Xiaoman will not speak yet. Promise something and ask again.
next.zh: 小满还不肯开口。许点好处再来问。

next.en: Xiaoman does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow evening.
next.zh: 小满还信不过你。明天傍晚再去聊聊。

next.en: Xiaoman fishes by the river at night and is home in the evening. Ask what was seen that night.
next.zh: 小满夜里常在河边钓鱼，傍晚在家。去问问那晚看见了什么。

next.en: The night watchman will not speak yet. Go and talk first.
next.zh: 更夫还不肯开口。先去聊几句。

next.en: The night watchman will not speak yet. Promise something and ask again.
next.zh: 更夫还不肯开口。许点好处再来问。

next.en: The night watchman does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow afternoon.
next.zh: 更夫还信不过你。明天下午再去聊聊。

next.en: The night watchman is at the watch post in the afternoon. Ask what was seen that night.
next.zh: 下午更夫在更铺里。去问问那晚看见了什么。

next.en: By day see the bridge and the ferry, in the evening Xiaoman, and on the fourth afternoon the night watchman. Once the card is complete, go and speak in public.
next.zh: 白天去桥上和渡口看看，傍晚找小满。第四天下午再找更夫。讲稿写全了，就去当众说清楚。

text.en: Find out how the bridge broke and say it in public
text.zh: 先把桥的事查清，当众说出来

why.en: The matter of the bridge has been cleared in public, and Granny Li has not yet given way.
why.zh: 桥的事当众说清了，李老太却还没松口。

why.en: Granny Li lends no bamboo until the matter of the bridge is set straight in public. Nobody in town is talking about it, so look into it yourself.
why.zh: 李老太要等桥的事当众说清，才肯借竹料。镇上没人在传这事，得你自己去查。

blocker.en: The elder will not call the clan yet

next.en: Talk with the elder first, so that the elder comes to trust you, then ask again.
next.zh: 先和族长聊几句，让族长信得过你。再请族长召集。

next.en: Promise the elder something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许族长一件事，再请族长召集。

next.en: Ask the elder again tomorrow, when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，明天再请族长召集。

why.en: The elder wants to know you better and to see part of the town behind you.
why.zh: 族长要先信得过你，也要看到镇上有人站在你这边。

next.en: In the morning ask the elder at the hall to call the clan, then show your proof in front of them.
next.zh: 上午去祠堂请族长召集族人，再当着族人的面拿出凭据。

text.en: Have the elder call the clan

why.en: The elder will not call the clan for nothing. You need proof in hand, and the elder has to trust you. Part of the town has to be behind you as well.
why.zh: 族长不会随便召集族人。你手里得有凭据，族长也得信得过你。镇上还得有人站在你这边。

variants.label: 船夫老何夜里撑船撞的，瞒着没说

text.en: In five days, both families crossing the bridge with their lanterns, together
text.zh: 五天后，让李、周两家一起提灯过桥

text.en: Someone to set straight, in public, the talk that Li Er wrecked the bridge
text.zh: 有人出来把「李二毁桥」这话当众说清

text.en: Granny Li's nod before any bamboo leaves the store
text.zh: 李老太点了头，竹料才能动

text.en: To be rid of the talk about the broken railing, and to find the lantern lost in the river
text.zh: 洗掉毁桥的闲话，再找回掉进河里的灯笼

text.en: A ledger that balances, with someone paying for the timber and someone returning the favours
text.zh: 铺子的账要平，木料有人付钱，人情有人还

text.en: To be left out of the blame for the bridge
text.zh: 别再有人把桥的事算到自己头上

text.en: To be left in peace with a jug of wine
A full house on festival night, and every piece of news going out first from the teahouse tables
text.zh: 灯会那夜茶馆满座，镇上的新鲜事头一个从茶桌上传出去

text.en: To be listened to when speaking of what is seen at night
text.zh: 夜里看到的事，也能有人听进去

text.en: To be left alone with the ferry
